description: Public Agent Skills issue cases for capability-demand research. Evidence status records how far each reported diagnosis has been independently supported; it does not promote vendor issue claims by editorial confidence.

episodes.title: run_eval.py: claude -p never triggers skills/commands (0% trigger rate across all queries)
episodes.candidate_discriminator: verify the skill is actually exposed and observable before treating zero trigger rate as description/model failure

episodes.title: skill-creator: run_eval.py parallel workers cross-match skill UUIDs, producing false-negative trigger rates
episodes.candidate_discriminator: compare parallel and isolated/serial trigger evaluation under the same skill description; current source confirms shared project registration, per-query UUID names, parallel execution, and exact per-query UUID matching, but the claimed trigger-rate consequence is not independently replayed here

episodes.title: claude-api skill eagerly injects ~156k tokens, exhausting the context window in a single tool call
episodes.candidate_discriminator: measure task-relevant loaded references versus eager payload and next-action preservation under progressive disclosure

episodes.title: document-skills and example-skills plugins install identical content, causing duplicate skills
episodes.candidate_discriminator: fingerprint loaded skill content and distinguish duplicate bytes from additional decision-relevant evidence

episodes.title: Windows compatibility: skill-creator scripts fail (subprocess PATHEXT, cp1252 encoding, select on pipes)
episodes.candidate_discriminator: run the same eval workflow under declared platform/tool affordances before attributing failure to the worker

episodes.title: Security: Community skills distributed under anthropic/ namespace enable trust boundary abuse
episodes.candidate_discriminator: bind skill content to verifiable origin identity instead of inferring provenance from a path namespace

episodes.title: claude-api skill description truncated in Claude Code listings
episodes.candidate_discriminator: compare authored activation metadata with the exact metadata actually exposed to the selector

episodes.title: gh-address-comments can't find scripts/fetch_comments.py and falls back to GraphQL
episodes.candidate_discriminator: resolve helper references against an explicit skill root instead of the target repository cwd

episodes.title: [skill-creator] Document portable Python invocation for non-executable helper scripts
episodes.candidate_discriminator: execute documented helpers from both skill root and unrelated workspace using explicit interpreter/root coordinates

episodes.title: quick_validate.py fails on UTF-8 SKILL.md under Windows CP949
episodes.candidate_discriminator: replay validation under a non-UTF-8 locale and an explicit UTF-8 reader while holding skill bytes fixed

episodes.title: skill-creator validator fails when PyYAML is not available globally
episodes.candidate_discriminator: inventory required runtime dependencies before treating validator non-execution as skill/model failure

episodes.title: Should skill installs record origin metadata to enable safe updates?
episodes.candidate_discriminator: record exact repo/ref/commit origin so installed skill identity can be compared across updates

episodes.title: skill-installer and skill-creator still default to ~/.codex/skills while current docs point users toward ~/.agents/skills
episodes.candidate_discriminator: compare documented install root, tool-computed root, and runtime discovery precedence as separate identities

episodes.title: Allow compatibility property in frontmatter for consistency with Agent Skills Specification
episodes.candidate_discriminator: compare validator-admitted frontmatter fields against the exact declared specification version
